description: Test application, convert bugs to features, remediate, and produce session report.
name: test and remediate

configJson.prompt: Delete ingested bug entries from {application}/data/bugs.json. Only remove entries that have been successfully converted to feature.json files. If the file contains only placeholder or test entries after removal, delete the entire bugs.json file.
Delete resolved remediation feature directories from {application}/.aidd/features/ that have been fully remediated. Only remove directories whose feature.json indicates completion.

Create a session report at {application}/.aidd/reports/ with a timestamp filename. Include: time taken for each step, summary of bugs found, features created, remediations applied, and any issues encountered.
